entities.name: Nylah
entities.description: An Amonkheti mage who became a fervent believer in the God-Pharaoh during the Hours.

entities.name: God-Pharaoh
entities.description: Ruler of Amonkhet in whom Nylah believed.

entities.name: Final Hours
entities.description: Event when the gate to paradise opened to horror.

entities.name: Luxa River
entities.description: River filled with blood during the Final Hours.

events.summary: When the gate opened during the Final Hours, Nylah witnessed horror, destruction and the gods dying, and questioned their divinity.
events.quote: When the gate to paradise opened during the Final Hours , instead of divine bliss, she witnessed horror.

events.summary: Nylah witnessed the Scarab God arrive with the Eternals and desired their fate.
events.quote: Nylah witnessed the arrival of a dread figure

events.summary: Nylah embraced the Eternals and was stabbed to death, believing her faith rewarded.
events.quote: She shouted her belief as they swarmed and stabbed her

relations.quote: She shouted her belief as they swarmed and stabbed her
followed by an army of the worthy dead
